## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated; `make test` passes
- [ ] `make lint` passes (ruff + mypy); `make ui-check` if `web/ui` changed
- [ ] Docs updated in both English and Chinese (README / README.zh-CN / `docs/`) where behavior changed
- [ ] DFM rules/thresholds: source or "rule of thumb" label stated in code and `docs/dfm-rules.md`
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md `Unreleased` updated for user-visible changes
- [ ] No secrets, API keys, Feishu tokens or `.env` contents in the diff
